summary: Single rollup of runtime activation readiness for the Collection Synergy V2 and Affinity Phase 2 sub-systems. Aggregates the status of every preceding readiness artifact (CS2-A..E, AF2-A..H, STACK-A..F, AXIS-A..E, UI-PREVIEW-A). The rollup is the source of truth for the GO/NO-GO decision before any runtime feature flag is flipped. Current status: NO-GO.
